pr_title: Fix cross-attention head mask for Torch encoder-decoder models
pr_body:
1. This PR fixes head masking for the cross-attention module in the following models:

- BART,
- Blenderbot,
- Blenderbot_small,
- FSMT,
- LED,
- M2M_100,
- Marian,
- MBart,
- Pegasus.
- T5

2. This PR also contains slight changes in docstrings so that it will be clear that `head_mask` is related to the config of an encoder and the shape of `decoder_head_mask` and `cross_head_mask` depends on the config of a decoder.
 
3. This PR enables `test_headmasking` for M2M_100 model.

<hr>

**Reviewers:** @patrickvonplaten @patil-suraj 

<hr>

Fixes: #10540

issue_context.title: 🐛 Bug in attention head mask for cross-attention module in encoder-decoder models
issue_context.body:
Currently, encoder-decoder models use either `head_mask` or `decoder_head_mask` for masking attention heads in cross-attention modules. Both cases are not perfectly correct. Furthermore, MHA in cross-attention modules shares the parameters with the decoder, i.e. `shape = (decoder.num_layers, decoder.num_attention_heads)`, therefore, the usage of encoder `head_mask` in the cross-attention module may lead to errors due to the shape mismatch.

<hr>

**My contribution:** I will take care of this issue this weekend.

<hr>

**Reviewers:** @patil-suraj @patrickvonplaten
